<details open>

hexagon: update to snapdragon-toolchain v0.8 and enable hexagon v85 (#30854)

* hex-build: bump toolchain, enable v85

* hex-build: bump toolchain to v0.8 in the CI and build scripts

* hex-build: add a little python script for swiv needed on some iot devices

* hex-build: fix flake8 warnings

* hex-arch: update version cap to v85

* hex-inspect: flexible TOOLS_ROOT

* hex-build: update to snake_case naming

* hex-build: update leftover old toolchain refs

* hex-target: update build and run scripts to support ubuntu with adb transport

</details>
